S2.rationale: The primary model can select tasks isolation worktree for simultaneous writing subagents; separate branches/worktrees attenuate edit interference and return change/merge information. S3.rationale: Current parent delegation and hierarchical limits constrain per-batch execution but do not show whole-fleet live priorities/resource reallocations. Open issue signals checked focus on PTY test flakiness, sandbox tier and dependency updates, not a requested first-party S3 manager.

No specific false-negative reviewer failure or native audit fix is supported by this assessment; do not manufacture one to improve its grade.

S4.rationale: Retrieval, skills, session replay/fork and model selection inform a task but do not autonomously adopt future organizational capability changes. This does not demonstrate that its users need autonomous S4 or that a persistent adaptation change improves the Community Edition.

S5.rationale: Policies, managed configuration and human approvals constrain action execution but do not close ultimate identity-policy decisions at the assessed agent boundary. No first-party feature request establishes a bounded S5 product intervention; product policy ownership remains external.
